spans.s: + अङ्कुर स्मर- + अङ्कुर, m. 1. a lover, a lecher. 2. a finger nail.

+ ध्वज स्मर- + ध्वज,
 I. m. 1. any musical instrument. 2. a fabulous fish, the makara. 3. the penis.
 II. f. जा, bright moonlight.
 III. n. the vulva.
+ वाट श्मशान- + वाट, m. a cemetery,
+ वेश्मन् श्मशान- + वेश्मन्, m. 1. Śiva. 2. a ghost.
+ शवर स्मर- + शवर, m. the शवर- like (i. e. cruel) god of love,

श्मशान, i. e. probably श्मन् (for शम् + अन्, cf. κμης in σιδηρο-κμής), -शयन, n. A cemetery, Pañc. v. d. 6.
 --Comp.
श्मश्रु + ल, adj. Having a beard,
; one who lets grow his beard,
+ स्तम्भ स्मर- + स्तम्भ, m. the penis.

स्म, an old case (probably the instr. sing. n.) of सम; a particle.
 1. A present and ptcple. of the pres. followed by it have generally a past sense; e. g. प्रति वसतः, स्म, They dwelt, Pañc. 43, 1; कथयन्तौ स्म...आसाताम्,

, They were sitting and told.
 2. Preceded by मा, sometimes after a present, and in the Ved., after particles, it has no distinct signification; मा स्म कार्षीस्, Do not,

स्मय, i. e. स्मि + अ, m.
 1. Surprise, astonishment.
 2. Arrogance, pride,

स्मर, i. e. स्मृ + अ, m.
 1.

. Kāma, the god of love, Pañc. 226, 1; Śāk. d. 119 (and at the same time, perhaps, Remembrance).
 --Comp.

स्मरण, i. e. स्मृ + अन, n.
 1. Remembering, Hit. ii. d. 56; remembrance, Pañc. 208, 14.
 2. Memory,
 3. Regretting.
 --Comp.
स्मारण, i. e. स्मृ, Caus., + अन, n. Calling to mind, causing to remember.
स्मर्तृ, i. e. स्मृ + तृ, m., f. त्री, n. Who or what remembers, Bhāg.

स्मार्त, i. e. स्मृति + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Memorial, relating to memory.
 2. Within memory.
 3. Recorded in the स्मृतिस्, or codes of law,

. Following or professing the law books.
 II. m. A Brāhmaṇa following the revealed law; one who knows the traditional law, Pañc. i. d. 283.
+ हर स्मर- + हर, m. Śiva, Kāvya
